sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 最终，侦探们查明了她的名字：艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: 6.36am on May 22, 1994, police negotiator Detective Wayne Gordon dialed through to the telephone located inside the home of Ivan Malat.
sentences.zh: 1994年5月22日凌晨6点36分，警方谈判专家韦恩·戈登（Wayne Gordon）警探拨通了伊万·米拉特（Ivan Milat）家中的电话。

sentences.en: The early morning call stirred Ivan from his sleep, and when he picked up, Detective Gordon
sentences.zh: 清晨的电话将伊万从睡梦中惊醒，当他接起电话时，戈登警探

sentences.en: introduced himself and advised Ivan that his Cinnabar Street property was surrounded by heavily armed officers enacting a search warrant in relation to an armed robbery.
sentences.zh: 自报家门，并告知伊万，他位于朱砂街（Cinnabar Street）的房产已被全副武装的警员包围，警方正在执行与一起武装抢劫案有关的搜查令。

sentences.en: Ivan was instructed to exit the house via the front door, turn left, and then walk through the front gate with his arms raised.
sentences.zh: 伊万被要求从前门离开房屋，向左转，然后举起双手穿过前门。

sentences.en: Dumbfounded, Ivan responded,
sentences.zh: 伊万被搞糊涂了，回应道：

sentences.en: Okie dokie, just let me put me pants on.
sentences.zh: 好的好的，让我先穿上裤子。

sentences.en: Five minutes ticked by, but there was no sign of Ivan.
sentences.zh: 五分钟过去了，却不见伊万的踪影。

sentences.en: Detective Gordon called the house once more, and Ivan's partner Chalinda answered before handing the receiver over to her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 戈登警探再次拨打了电话，伊万的伴侣查琳达（Chalinda）接听了电话，随后将听筒交给了她的男友。

sentences.en: When asked why he hadn't followed orders, Ivan expressed his disbelief about the entire situation, certain the negotiator was one of his workmates playing a prank.
sentences.zh: 当被问及为何不听从命令时，伊万表达了他对整个局面的难以置信，他确信这位谈判专家是他同事搞的恶作剧。

sentences.en: Detective Gordon responded,
sentences.zh: 戈登警探回应道：

sentences.en: No mate, I'm from the police.
sentences.zh: 不，伙计，我是警察。

sentences.en: It's no joke.
sentences.zh: 这不是开玩笑。

sentences.en: This is real.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: Still unsure, Ivan queried,
sentences.zh: 伊万仍然半信半疑，质问道：

sentences.en: Why didn't you knock on the bloody door or something?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么不敲那该死的门或者干点别的？

sentences.en: Gordon informed him that it was standard police procedure to first make a call to ensure the safety of all concerned.
sentences.zh: 戈登告知他，为了确保所有相关人员的安全，先打个电话是警方的标准程序。

sentences.en: Ivan chuckled, still in disbelief, and told the negotiator he couldn't see anybody outside his window.
sentences.zh: 伊万轻笑了一声，依然不信，并告诉谈判专家他窗外一个人影都没看见。

sentences.en: Gordon once again ordered him to walk outside and turn left at the gate, but this command only amplified Ivan's doubt as he didn't have a gate on his property.
sentences.zh: 戈登再次命令他走出门外并在门口向左转，但这个命令反而加深了伊万的怀疑，因为他的房产根本没有门。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, he announced,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他还是宣布：

sentences.en: Alright, I'll play your little game.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我陪你们玩玩这个小游戏。

sentences.en: But I'm not real keen on this.
sentences.zh: 但我对此一点兴趣都没有。

sentences.en: Officers covering the inner perimeter of the premises radioed through to their command post
sentences.zh: 负责包围该处房产内围的警员通过无线电向指挥部报告，

sentences.en: advising they could hear movement inside the garage, including what sounded like a car door opening and closing.
sentences.zh: 称他们能听到车库内有动静，包括听起来像是车门开关的声音。

sentences.en: They expressed concern that Ivan was planning an escape.
sentences.zh: 他们表示担心伊万正计划逃跑。

sentences.en: By 6.48am, their suspect still hadn't emerged from the house, so Detective Gordon phoned for a third time.
sentences.zh: 到了凌晨6点48分，嫌疑人仍未走出屋子，于是戈登警探第三次拨打了电话。

sentences.en: Chalinda answered again, saying, We are coming out now.
sentences.zh: 查琳达再次接听，说道：“我们现在就出来。”

sentences.en: He's just trying to find his keys.
sentences.zh: “他只是在找钥匙。”

sentences.en: He always loses them in the morning.
sentences.zh: “他每天早上总是丢三落四的。”

sentences.en: A few minutes later, Ivan the Lat walked out of the house.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，伊万·米拉特走出了屋子。

sentences.en: With his hands up, Ivan complied with orders to get on the ground as two heavily armed police
sentences.zh: 伊万举着双手，遵照命令趴在地上，两名全副武装的警察

sentences.en: officers placed him in handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 给他戴上了手铐。

sentences.en: Chalinda exited the premises soon after and was escorted to a waiting police car.
sentences.zh: 查琳达随后也离开了住所，被护送至一辆等候的警车上。

sentences.en: Detectives showed Ivan a copy of their search warrant, informing him that they were making inquiries in relation to the 1990 armed robbery of English backpacker Paul Unions,
sentences.zh: 侦探们向伊万出示了搜查令副本，告知他他们正在调查1990年英国背包客保罗·奥尼恩斯（Paul Onions）遭遇武装抢劫一案，

sentences.en: adding that they would also be asking questions in relation to the seven murdered backpackers discovered in Belangelo State ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 并补充说他们还将询问有关在贝朗格洛州立森林（Belangelo State Forest）发现的七名遇害背包客的情况。

sentences.en: Ivan responded,
sentences.zh: 伊万回应道：

sentences.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: Superintendent Clive Small was overseeing the raid from the police command poSt.
sentences.zh: 克莱夫·斯莫尔（Clive Small）警司正在警察指挥部监督此次突袭行动。

sentences.en: Once Ivan's house was cleared and it was confirmed that no one else was inside, he gave the go-ahead for officers to proceed with the next step.
sentences.zh: 在伊万的房子被清空并确认没有其他人后，他下令警员进行下一步行动。

sentences.en: Ivan was lifted to his feet and taken inside his home to give detectives an impromptu tour and explain the purpose of each room.
sentences.zh: 伊万被拉起来带进屋内，被迫带领侦探们进行了一次即兴参观，并解释每个房间的用途。

sentences.en: He was then left in the living room under the dutiful watch of two detectives as other officers initiated a full-scale search of the property.
sentences.zh: 随后，他被留在客厅，在两名侦探的严密监视下，其他警员开始对该房产进行全面搜查。

sentences.en: Police were equipped with a list of over 100 items to be on the lookout for, ranging from weapons and ammunition to the various items of clothing,
sentences.zh: 警方携带了一份包含100多件搜寻物品的清单，从武器和弹药到各种衣物，

sentences.en: jewellery and camping equipment the seven Belangelo victims were in possession of at the time of their disappearance.
sentences.zh: 以及七名贝朗格洛受害者失踪时随身携带的珠宝和露营装备。

sentences.en: As the search of Ivan's bedroom commenced, police discovered a driver's licence displaying Ivan's photograph alongside his brother Michael's name and personal information.
sentences.zh: 当搜查伊万的卧室时，警方发现了一张驾照，上面贴着伊万的照片，但名字和个人信息却是他弟弟迈克尔（Michael）的。

sentences.en: There was also a postcard written to Ivan dated just days after the disappearance of British backpackers
sentences.zh: 还有一张写给伊万的明信片，日期就在英国背包客

sentences.en: Joanne Walters and Caroline Clark that began with the words,
sentences.zh: 乔安妮·沃尔特斯（Joanne Walters）和卡罗琳·克拉克（Caroline Clark）失踪几天后，开头写着：

sentences.en: Hi Bill!
sentences.zh: 嗨，比尔（Bill）！

sentences.en: The false name he had given to Paul Onions.
sentences.zh: 这是他告诉保罗·奥尼恩斯的假名。

sentences.en: An envelope in his bedside drawer contained foreign currency, including New Zealand dollars and Indonesian rupiah,
sentences.zh: 床头柜抽屉里的一个信封里装有外币，包括新西兰元和印尼盾，

sentences.en: with print dates that didn't coincide with the time Ivan was known to be living outside of Australia.
sentences.zh: 其印刷日期与伊万在澳大利亚境外居住的时间不符。

sentences.en: German backpacker Simone Schmidl had returned from a trip to New Zealand just before her disappearance, and a German couple, Gabor Nogabauer and Dania Habschied,
sentences.zh: 德国背包客西蒙妮·施密德（Simone Schmidl）在失踪前刚从新西兰旅行回来，而一对德国夫妇，加博尔·诺格鲍尔（Gabor Nogabauer）和丹妮亚·哈布希德（Dania Habschied），

sentences.en: had travelled to Australia via Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 则是经由印度尼西亚前往澳大利亚的。

sentences.en: Ivan denied owning any firearms or keeping any on his property.
sentences.zh: 伊万否认拥有任何枪支或在房产内藏有枪支。

sentences.en: Yet, a large array of ammunition was discovered throughout his house.
sentences.zh: 然而，警方在他的房子里发现了大量的弹药。

sentences.en: A cupboard in Ivan's bedroom contained a tin storing .38 .22 calibre bullets and an unused 12-gauge shotgun cartridge.
sentences.zh: 伊万卧室的一个橱柜里有一个锡罐，里面装着.38和.22口径的子弹，以及一颗未使用的12号口径霰弹枪弹药。

sentences.en: Similarly, four boxes of Eely brand .22 calibre cartridges were uncovered in a spare bedroom,
sentences.zh: 同样，在备用卧室里发现了四盒Eely牌.22口径弹药，

sentences.en: featuring the same batch number as those recovered from the Area A location in Belangelo, near where the remains of Gabor Nogabauer and Dania Habschied were found.
sentences.zh: 其批号与在贝朗格洛A区发现的弹药相同，该处附近发现了加博尔·诺格鲍尔和丹妮亚·哈布希德的遗骸。

sentences.en: All of the .22 calibre ammunition found in Ivan's home was suited for use with the Ruger and Anschutz rifles fired by the Belangelo serial killer.
sentences.zh: 在伊万家中发现的所有.22口径弹药都适用于贝朗格洛连环杀手所使用的鲁格（Ruger）和安舒茨（Anschutz）步枪。

sentences.en: A plastic bag carried .32 and .45 calibre Winchester ammunition, the latter of which had copper tips, matching the bullets Paul Onion sighted in his attacker's revolver.
sentences.zh: 一个塑料袋里装着.32和.45口径的温彻斯特（Winchester）弹药，后者带有铜尖，与保罗·奥尼恩斯在袭击者左轮手枪中看到的子弹相符。

sentences.en: The bag also contained a spent .22 Winchester cartridge with a unique upward indentation,
sentences.zh: 袋子里还装有一枚用过的.22温彻斯特弹壳，上面有一个独特的向上压痕，

sentences.en: a marking caused by a known firing pin fault in Ruger rifles manufactured between 1964 and 1982.
sentences.zh: 这是1964年至1982年间生产的鲁格步枪中已知的击针故障所导致的标记。

sentences.en: The exact same indentation was present on cartridges recovered from two of the Belangelo crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 在贝朗格洛两个犯罪现场发现的弹壳上，也存在完全相同的压痕。

sentences.en: Ivan's bedroom drawer also held a receipt for a pump-action shotgun purchased from a gun shop in the western Sydney suburb of Horsley Park.
sentences.zh: 伊万的卧室抽屉里还有一张收据，显示他从悉尼西部霍斯利公园（Horsley Park）的一家枪店购买了一把泵动式霰弹枪。

sentences.en: During a search of the laundry, an officer's attention was drawn to the washing machine,
sentences.zh: 在搜查洗衣房时，一名警员注意到洗衣机，

sentences.en: where he noticed a substantial gap between the base of the appliance and the floor underneath.
sentences.zh: 他发现洗衣机底部与地面之间有很大的缝隙。

sentences.en: He got down on the floor and discovered a .32 Browning pistol, which appeared to have been slid under the washing machine in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 他趴在地上，发现了一把.32口径勃朗宁（Browning）手枪，看起来像是被匆忙塞进洗衣机下面的。

sentences.en: Subsequent enquiries would reveal the pistol had been stolen during a break-in at the office of the Roads and Traffic Authority near Campbelltown in August 1977.
sentences.zh: 随后的调查显示，这把手枪是1977年8月在坎贝尔敦（Campbelltown）附近的道路与交通管理局办公室失窃的。

sentences.en: A cupboard in Ivan's hallway contained a pair of his work boots, one of which had a Ruger rifle receiver stuffed inside.
sentences.zh: 伊万走廊的一个橱柜里装有一双他的工作靴，其中一只里面塞着一个鲁格步枪机匣。

sentences.en: The receiver is the frame of the firearm that houses the internal components, such as the firing mechanism and the bolt.
sentences.zh: 机匣是枪支的框架，容纳了内部组件，如击发机构和枪机。

sentences.en: In addition, there was a map of the Southern Highlands region, including the Belangelo State Forest, plus maps of Newcastle and Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一张南部高地地区的地图，包括贝朗格洛州立森林，以及纽卡斯尔（Newcastle）和卧龙岗（Wollongong）的地图。

sentences.en: When asked if he had ever been to Belangelo,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否去过贝朗格洛时，

sentences.en: Ivan claimed to have only ever bypassed the forest down a dirt track during the mid-80s.
sentences.zh: 伊万声称他只在80年代中期沿着一条土路绕过森林。

sentences.en: In response to whether he owned a Ruger firearm, Ivan said,
sentences.zh: 在回答是否拥有鲁格枪支时，伊万说：

sentences.en: I've told you before, I don't own any weapons.
sentences.zh: 我之前告诉过你，我不拥有任何武器。

sentences.en: The group of attending police officers conducted the most thorough search possible, ensuring nothing in the house went untouched.
sentences.zh: 在场的警员进行了尽可能彻底的搜查，确保屋内的任何东西都没有被遗漏。

sentences.en: By the time they were through, numerous items of interest had been recovered, including a foot-long bowie knife, three magazines about shooting,
sentences.zh: 当他们搜查完毕时，已经找回了许多重要物品，包括一把一英尺长的博伊刀（bowie knife）、三本关于射击的杂志，

sentences.en: a homemade silencer, multiple rolls of black electrical tape, cable ties, telescopic sights, a camouflage-coloured paintball mask,
sentences.zh: 一个自制消音器、多卷黑色电工胶带、扎带、望远瞄准镜、一个迷彩色的彩弹面具，

sentences.en: and a police radio scanner with Ivan Milat's name engraved on it.
sentences.zh: 以及一个刻有伊万·米拉特名字的警用无线电扫描仪。

sentences.en: The electrical tape and cable ties matched those used to construct a leash restraint device that had been found at one Belangelo crime scene.
sentences.zh: 电工胶带和扎带与在一个贝朗格洛犯罪现场发现的皮带约束装置所使用的材料相符。

sentences.en: Police also found an Olympus brand Trip S model 35mm camera, which was only available for sale in the United Kingdom
sentences.zh: 警方还发现了一台奥林巴斯（Olympus）Trip S型35毫米相机，该型号仅在英国有售，

sentences.en: and matched the camera owned by English backpacker Caroline Clark.
sentences.zh: 且与英国背包客卡罗琳·克拉克拥有的相机相符。

sentences.en: Stuffed inside a garbage bag in Ivan's sister Shirley's bedroom, police found a green and purple Salewa brand sleeping bag
sentences.zh: 在伊万的妹妹雪莉（Shirley）卧室的一个垃圾袋里，警方发现了一个绿色和紫色的Salewa牌睡袋，

sentences.en: identified as belonging to German backpacker Simone Schmidl.
sentences.zh: 经鉴定属于德国背包客西蒙妮·施密德。

sentences.en: In addition to the sleeping bag, a Mark Hill brand cooking set and cups found in the kitchen pantry were confirmed to be the same type carried by Simone,
sentences.zh: 除了睡袋，在厨房储藏室发现的一套Mark Hill牌炊具和杯子也被证实与西蒙妮携带的类型相同，

sentences.en: as was a carrying pouch and green water bottle found in a cardboard box.
sentences.zh: 在一个纸板箱里发现的携带袋和绿色水壶也是如此。

sentences.en: A search of the garage revealed more items of camping equipment similar to those owned by Simone, including a multi-coloured Arno strap and a blue Salewa sleeping bag cover.
sentences.zh: 对车库的搜查发现了更多与西蒙妮拥有的类似的露营装备，包括一条多色Arno带子和一个蓝色Salewa睡袋套。

sentences.en: The cover contained a green Vaudé brand Hogan Model 10 tied with a compacto-mat band, the same as the one found tied around Simone's head upon the discovery of her remains.
sentences.zh: 睡袋套里装着一个绿色的Vaudé牌Hogan 10型帐篷，用一条compacto-mat带子捆绑，这与发现西蒙妮遗骸时捆在她头上的带子一模一样。

sentences.en: A second green and beige sleeping bag was identified as the one Australian backpacker Deborah Everest had borrowed from her brother before her trip to Sydney in 1989.
sentences.zh: 第二个绿色和米色的睡袋被确认为澳大利亚背包客黛博拉·埃弗雷斯特（Deborah Everest）在1989年去悉尼旅行前从她哥哥那里借来的那个。

sentences.en: Police also found a striped green pillowcase with five lengths of sash cord inside,
sentences.zh: 警方还发现了一个条纹绿色枕套，里面有五段窗帘绳，

sentences.en: one of which appeared to be stained with blood.
sentences.zh: 其中一段似乎沾有血迹。

sentences.en: A red Holden Jackaroo four-wheel drive was parked in Ivan's garage, though he claimed he hadn't owned a car for the past six years
sentences.zh: 伊万的车库里停着一辆红色霍顿（Holden）Jackaroo四驱车，尽管他声称过去六年里他没有拥有过汽车，

sentences.en: and that the vehicle belonged to one of his brothers.
sentences.zh: 并称这辆车属于他的一个兄弟。

sentences.en: Inside the vehicle was a British 20-pence coin with a print date of 1989.
sentences.zh: 车内有一枚1989年印刷的英国20便士硬币。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most bizarre of all was a sticker on the back of the vehicle which promoted a crime prevention service,
sentences.zh: 最离奇的或许是车后贴着的一张贴纸，宣传的是一项犯罪预防服务，

sentences.en: Crimestoppers, with its motto reading,
sentences.zh: “灭罪热线”（Crimestoppers），其座右铭写着：

sentences.en: Put the Finger on Crime.
sentences.zh: “指认犯罪”。

sentences.en: A manhole was used to access the roof cavity of Ivan's home, where police found some Christmas decorations and other boxes containing miscellaneous iteMs.
sentences.zh: 警方利用一个人孔进入伊万家的屋顶空腔，在那里发现了一些圣诞装饰品和其他装有杂物的盒子。

sentences.en: But upon removing some sheets of insulation, they were able to peer down into the wall cavities, where they spotted a plastic bag resting behind the living room wall.
sentences.zh: 但在移开一些隔热层后，他们得以窥视墙壁空腔，发现客厅墙后放着一个塑料袋。

sentences.en: A stick was used to try to reach the bag, but in doing so, it caused something to dislodge and fall further down into the space.
sentences.zh: 他们用一根棍子试图够到那个袋子，但在操作过程中，导致某样东西松动并掉进了更深的空间。

sentences.en: A hole was cut through the wall to retrieve the item, which was revealed to be a 10-shot Ruger rifle magazine.
sentences.zh: 墙上被凿开了一个洞以取回该物品，结果发现是一个10发装的鲁格步枪弹匣。
